title: TikTok Business Center: Setup, Login, and Where TikTok Shop Fits
summary: Learn what TikTok Business Center is, how to sign up and log in, how it differs from Business Manager and Business Suite, and where TikTok Shop fits into your setup.
body_markdown:
## What TikTok Business Center Is (and What It Is Not)


**TikTok Business Center** is a workspace for organizing business assets and granting team members or partners access to them. TikTok’s Business Help Center describes it as a place to manage accounts, people, and permissions. It is not the ad-buying interface or the system for managing shop orders. Think of it as an administrative hub: it helps control access to connected tools, while each tool retains its own purpose.


TikTok’s official business and advertising pages use related names for different functions. Check the task you need to complete before choosing a destination.


### The Full TikTok Naming Stack: Business Center vs. Business Manager vs. Business Suite vs. Ads Manager vs. Seller Center


[Business Manager](https://www.reacherapp.com/blog/tiktok-business-manager-explained-setup-login-and-how-it-differs-from-ads-manager) is often used informally to describe business account administration, which can lead people to mistake it for a separate product. Business Suite is the broader business-facing environment, while Ads Manager is where advertisers build and manage campaigns. Seller Center is oriented to shop operations. Use the distinction below to identify the right starting point.


Tool name Main purpose Use it when you need to


Business Center Organize assets, people, and permissions Control team or partner access


Business Manager Common label for business administration Confirm whether the instructions refer to Business Center


Business Suite Business-facing environment for TikTok tools Find business functions and account resources


Ads Manager Advertising campaign management Create, manage, or review paid campaigns


Seller Center TikTok Shop seller operations Manage shop activity and selling tasks


### Business Center vs. Meta Business Portfolio


Both systems help businesses organize access to accounts and assets, but they belong to different platforms. Meta Business Portfolio organizes Meta business assets; TikTok’s administrative hub organizes access to TikTok business assets. Neither is a universal login or a replacement for platform-specific tools used to run ads or manage commerce.

Platform TikTok Meta


Core function Manage TikTok asset access and people Organize Meta business assets and access


Does it replace the ad tool? No, Ads Manager serves campaign work No, Meta’s ad tools serve campaign work


### Yes, It Is Free, Here Is Where the Costs Actually Sit


TikTok Business Center is free to create and use. TikTok’s official Business Center information distinguishes the workspace from advertising spend: brands pay for ads they run, not for creating the center. Evaluate separate services, campaign budgets, and shop-related costs on their own terms rather than assuming they are part of the workspace fee.
